serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
???: Eeeek! {{punch}}
My ears are ringing…
I almost can’t hear the screams of the people nearby.
They run, reach for their phones, but I don’t care… {{wi}}I should run, but I can’t move my legs…
All of my attention is on the lifeless body in front of me…
I can’t believe I’ve done this. {{wi}}Why? {{wi}} Was I really in the right?{{wi}} Maybe I was just blinded by anger and hopelessness.{{wi}} Was I?{{wi}} I can’t really remember…
There’s something on my face… {{wi}}It’s been bothering me for a while now, but I just couldn’t move…
It’s blood…{{wi}} and hair?
Bleh!
I vomited…
I puked all over myself, but it didn’t faze me at all. Not in the comparison of what I have done just moments before.
I can move my legs again… {{wi}}It’s time to run…
